title: os dev: every fresh dev database opens on the "Set the workspace timezone" dialog — the --seed-admin bootstrap creates the workspace without a timezone, unlike the console's creation path (objectui#11908)
body:
Filing-gate category ③ — the maintainer's order in PM session `session_016JB93R2KcQP4GgKaUnseVF`, verbatim: 「按这 5 类开父单，派给 objectui 车道，以及：820px 宽度下面包屑重叠。* 每个新库首屏都弹时区设置。* Home 页的应用卡片不是链接，没法在新标签页打开。」

QA-source: #23104 · (environment setup observation: every fresh DB of the browser pass)

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:cli` execution seat (the `os dev` admin seed). Routed on the maintainer's order above, which asked for this item to be handled with the objectui lane's batch; it lands here because the fix is in the CLI's bootstrap, not the console. **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included, "workspace timezone prompt modal appears on every new workspace seed admin dev boot first run" — the nearest is objectstack-ai/objectui#11908 (closed), the console half below; no card covers the CLI path.

## What happens

`objectstack dev` seeds a dev admin by default (`--seed-admin`, on unless `--no-seed-admin`). A database bootstrapped that way has its workspace timezone at the manifest default, so the console's `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt` (objectui#11758) opens a modal over the shell on the first sign-in of every fresh dev database — every `--fresh` run, every new `-d file:` DB. Every boot of the #23104 browser pass hit it; the runners dismissed it with Escape.

## Why this is the CLI's to fix, not the prompt's

- The prompt is ruled behaviour: it asks an administrator ONCE when the timezone is still the default (objectstack-ai/objectui#11758, the prompt-and-confirm shape ruled on objectstack-ai/objectui#11693). This card does not change it.
- The console's own workspace-creation path already sends the creator's timezone so a new workspace never shows the prompt: objectstack-ai/objectui#11908 (closed; the objectui half of cloud#2676), and `apps/console/src/pages/auth/SetupPage.tsx` sends `browserTimeZone()` on first-run setup.
- The `os dev` seed bypasses that path, so it creates exactly the workspace the console path no longer creates.

## Where (objectstack `main`)

`packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` — the `seed-admin` flag (default on) handed to the runtime as `OS_SEED_ADMIN`; the in-process seed it triggers is where the workspace gets its first settings. Which zone to seed (the host's resolved zone, an explicit flag, or both) is the fixing seat's call; the console precedent seeds the creator's own zone.

## Expected

A database the `os dev` seed bootstraps opens straight on the shell, its workspace timezone already set, as a console-created workspace does.
